statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I47.1)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated to capture frequency and duration of intermittent symptomatic events
